inputs.text: If the court documents are accurate, this is not a defense of strong borders—it is a failure of basic honesty and lawful authority. ICE lawyers reportedly used a May memo to justify arresting thousands of people at immigration courts, while prosecutors now say it authorized no such arrests. A nation has every right to enforce its immigration laws, but officials must do so truthfully and within the law. People who show up for a legal proceeding should not be made to feel they have walked into a trap. That kind of conduct weakens public trust and makes it harder for responsible authorities to maintain order.
